title.en: Home page content: under the film
title.zh: 首頁內容：影片底下的部分

intro.en: Versions of the home page under the Barcelona film. Each opens straight on the page, with no opening in front; the opening is decided and lives on the real site. Scroll all the way down on each. On a page, , and . move between versions, 1 to 5 scores, N opens your notes, M marks a spot, B comes back here.
intro.zh: 巴塞隆納影片底下的首頁內容。每一版直接從頁面開始，前面不再播開場；開場已經定了，在正式網站上。每一版都請捲到底。在版本頁上，, 和 . 換版本，1 到 5 評分，N 寫筆記，M 標記一個地方，B 回到這裡。

title.en: Second round: the rest of the page, under E's opening
title.zh: 第二輪：E 的開場之後，首頁其餘的部分

title.en: Third round: from Singita, Belmond and Jimmy Chin, which you marked Good
title.zh: 第三輪：從你標喜歡的 Singita、Belmond、Jimmy Chin 來做

title.en: Fourth round: bold makeovers of 12, with the Queensboro train
title.zh: 第四輪：大膽改造第 12 個，主角是皇后區那張列車

title.en: Fifth round: the live site's layering, taken further
title.zh: 第五輪：把正式網站的層疊捲動做得更多

title.en: Home content, round one: three structures, on the real page
title.zh: 首頁內容第一輪：三種結構，接在正式首頁上

title.en: The index of places, four ways that move (top-design and animate skills)
title.zh: 地方的索引：四種會動的做法（用 top-design 和 animate 技能）

title.en: Drawn, then real, all the way down

desc.en: E's opening, then the same move as the opening all the way down: each photograph first appears as its own pencil drawing and turns into the photograph once it is well in view. Five photographs at changing sizes, two quiet sentences, the three doors.
desc.zh: E 的開場之後，整頁都用開場同一招：每張照片先以鉛筆素描出現，捲到畫面中間時才變成真的照片。五張照片大小交錯，兩句安靜的話，最後三個入口。

desc.en: E's opening, then one photograph to a screen: as you scroll, each print slides up and lies on top of the last, like prints in a pile, each with its place and when beneath. The way in becomes three photographs, Gallery, Journey and Guides.
desc.zh: E 的開場之後，一個畫面一張照片：往下捲，每張照片滑上來蓋住上一張，像桌上一疊照片，下面寫地點和時間。最後的入口變成三張照片：作品集、旅程、攻略。

desc.en: E's opening, then four spreads of a printed travel journal: the photograph on one page, and on the other its place, when, and how it was made (camera, lens, aperture, shutter, ISO, read from the file), with a link to more from that country. The way in becomes a contents page with real counts.
desc.zh: E 的開場之後，像一本印出來的旅行手帳翻開四頁：一邊是照片，另一邊寫地點、時間和怎麼拍的（相機、鏡頭、光圈、快門、ISO，從照片檔案讀出來），再連到那個國家的更多照片。最後的入口變成目錄，附上真實的數字。

desc.en: After Singita. E's opening, then three big photographs, each with one short line beside it, never on it, the sides swapping. The way in is three tall photographs like windows (after Belmond): Gallery, Journey, Guides, each name beneath.
desc.zh: 從 Singita 來的。E 的開場之後，三張大照片，每張旁邊一句短短的話（不寫在照片上），左右交換。最後的入口是三張直的照片，像窗戶（從 Belmond 來的）：作品集、旅程、攻略，名字寫在下面。

desc.en: After Belmond. E's opening, then one row of six tall photographs across the whole width, one place each, the country and when beneath; each opens that country. Then the three words (after Jimmy Chin) under one photograph that fills the screen.
desc.zh: 從 Belmond 來的。E 的開場之後，一整排六張直的照片橫跨整個畫面，一張一個地方，下面寫國家和時間，點了就到那個國家。最後是三個大字（從 Jimmy Chin 來的），在一張撐滿畫面的照片下面。

desc.en: After Jimmy Chin. E's opening, two big photographs, then one that fills the screen with GALLERY, JOURNEY, GUIDES set huge and wide-spaced on the paper just beneath it, as the only way in. Nothing is written on the photograph.
desc.zh: 從 Jimmy Chin 來的。E 的開場之後，兩張大照片，然後一張撐滿畫面的照片，下面紙上只有三個很大、很開的字：作品集、旅程、攻略，這就是入口。照片上不寫字。

title.en: Your current home and the three words

desc.en: Your ask: the three words merged with your current home. E's opening, then your live home page's own sections exactly as they are now (the line and its two buttons, the aurora, the Photographs wall with its viewer, Fuji, the Guides cards), then its last photograph, the Matterhorn and the flag, fills the screen with GALLERY, JOURNEY, GUIDES beneath it, and your Instagram footer closes it. The sections are read from the live page each time it is built, so they stay current.
desc.zh: 照你說的：三個字和現在的首頁合在一起。E 的開場之後，接上現在正式首頁的內容，原封不動（那句話和兩個按鈕、極光、照片牆和點開的看圖、富士山、攻略卡片），最後那張馬特洪峰和國旗撐滿畫面，下面是作品集、旅程、攻略三個大字，再接你的 Instagram 頁尾。這些內容每次建置都從正式首頁讀進來，所以會跟著更新。

desc.en: Each place is a chapter on its own flat colour, its name set very large beside the photograph: New York in clay with the Queensboro train, Zermatt in slate, Sa Pa in olive, Mount Fuji on stone. Each photograph is uncovered upward as it arrives, like a print pulled from the tray. Then the three words under the aurora.
desc.zh: 每個地方是一章，各有一整片顏色，地名很大地放在照片旁邊：紐約配陶土色和皇后區列車、策馬特配石板藍、沙壩配橄欖綠、富士山配石頭色。照片出現時由下往上露出來，像從顯影盤拿起一張相片。最後是極光下的三個大字。

desc.en: One photograph to a screen like a magazine cover, its name set huge and split around it: Queensboro | Plaza, Mount | Fuji, Roys | Peak, Lake | Tekapo. The two halves slide in toward the photograph as it arrives. Then the three words under the Matterhorn.
desc.zh: 一個畫面一張照片，像雜誌封面，名字很大地拆在照片兩邊：Queensboro | Plaza、Mount | Fuji、Roys | Peak、Lake | Tekapo，捲到時兩半往照片靠過來。最後是馬特洪峰下的三個大字。

desc.en: Like a photographer's light table: one big print held on the left, your picks laid out beside it. Point at or tap any of them and it becomes the big print. The Queensboro train is on the table first. Then the three words under Roys Peak.
desc.zh: 像攝影師的看片桌：左邊一張大照片，右邊排著你的精選。滑過或點任何一張，它就變成大的那張。皇后區列車先放在桌上。最後是羅伊峰下的三個大字。

desc.en: Half the screen holds the photograph, the other half reads place by place: the place, its name, one line about what is in the photograph, when, and a link. As each place reaches the middle, its photograph takes over the held half. Queensboro Plaza first, then Zermatt at dusk, Sa Pa, Tekapo, the Calanque. Then the three words under Fuji.
desc.zh: 畫面一半放照片，另一半一個地方一個地方讀下去：地點、名稱、一句照片裡有什麼、時間、連結。每個地方捲到中間時，它的照片就換上那一半。先是皇后區廣場站，接著暮色的策馬特、沙壩、蒂卡波、昂沃峽灣。最後是富士山下的三個大字。

desc.en: Straight after the film, the way in: three tall windows with the three words large beneath them, the Milky Way for Gallery, the Queensboro train for Journey, the Sagrada Família for Guides. Then your picks at changing sizes, and one last line.
desc.zh: 影片一結束就是入口：三扇直的窗，下面是三個大字，銀河是作品集，皇后區列車是旅程，聖家堂是攻略。接著是你的精選照片大小交錯，最後一句話。

desc.en: The live site's windows (a hole cut in the page, the photograph fixed behind it, drifting slowly as you pass) in more shapes: the Queensboro train fills a whole screen, the Milky Way shows through a tall hole framed by paper, Mount Fuji through two holes side by side onto one photograph, rows of your picks between. The three words sit under Roys Peak, itself a window.
desc.zh: 正式網站的「窗」（頁面上挖一個洞，照片固定在後面，捲動時慢慢飄）做成更多形狀：皇后區列車撐滿一整個畫面，銀河從一個被紙框住的直窗看出去，富士山從並排的兩個洞看到同一張照片，中間是你的精選照片。三個大字在羅伊峰下面，那張也是一扇窗。

desc.en: One photograph holds the whole screen while your prints float up over it, some faster than others: first the Queensboro train behind Matterhorn, Sa Pa, Fuji and the church at Tekapo; then the aurora behind Roys Peak, the Calanque, the Golden Gate and the Milky Way. Then the three words under the Matterhorn.
desc.zh: 一張照片撐住整個畫面，你的照片一張張從上面飄過，有快有慢：先是皇后區列車在後面，飄過馬特洪峰、沙壩、富士山、蒂卡波的教堂；再換極光在後面，飄過羅伊峰、昂沃峽灣、金門大橋、銀河。最後是馬特洪峰下的三個大字。

desc.en: Version 12 with more layers: your live line and buttons, then the Queensboro train as a full window, the photo wall with your picks, Mount Fuji with the bullet train through two holes, your Guides cards, the Tekapo church through a framed hole, and the three words under the Matterhorn and the flag, now a window too. Your Instagram footer closes it.
desc.zh: 第 12 個多加幾層：正式首頁那句話和按鈕，接著皇后區列車一整扇窗，照片牆換成你的精選，富士山和新幹線從兩個洞看，攻略卡片，蒂卡波的教堂從一個被紙框住的洞看，最後是馬特洪峰和國旗下的三個大字，那張現在也是一扇窗，再接 Instagram 頁尾。

title.en: The photograph stays, the paper passes
title.zh: 照片不動，紙從上面經過

desc.en: Mostly photograph. Under Aoraki, four photographs stay where they are, the Queensboro train and the Milky Way kept whole on stone, the Matterhorn and Barcelona filling the window. Between them a short leaf of paper passes with one thing on it: the line, then Gallery, Journey, Guides, one at a time. No wall, no cards, no buttons.
desc.zh: 幾乎都是照片。Aoraki 之後，四張照片停在原地：皇后區列車和蒂卡波銀河完整地掛在石色底上，馬特洪峰和巴塞隆納佔滿畫面。中間經過一小張紙，上面只有一樣東西：那句話，然後作品集、旅程、攻略，一次一個。沒有照片牆、沒有卡片、沒有按鈕。

desc.en: The page is a list of twelve places in large type. The photograph of the place you are reading stays beside the list, whole, and changes as you scroll or point; the name takes you to that place. Three small words at the end lead to every place, every photograph, every trip.
desc.zh: 整頁是十二個地名的大字清單。你讀到哪個地方，它的照片就完整地停在旁邊，隨著捲動或游標換一張；點地名就去那個地方。最後三個小字帶你去所有地方、所有照片、每一趟旅行。

title.en: Pairs: a landscape and a city
title.zh: 一對一對：一張風景，一張城市

desc.en: Your two subjects hung side by side because they rhyme: Mount Fuji and Lower Manhattan in their reflections, the Queensboro train and the bullet train under Fuji, the lights of Hong Kong and of Zermatt, the terraces of Sa Pa and the stalls of Mong Kok. One pair to a screen, each hung differently, every photograph whole. Gallery, Journey and Guides close it as three words.
desc.zh: 你拍的兩種題材因為呼應而掛在一起：倒影裡的富士山和下曼哈頓、皇后區列車和富士山下的新幹線、香港和策馬特的燈火、沙壩的梯田和旺角的攤位。一個畫面一對，每一對掛法不同，每張都完整。最後是作品集、旅程、攻略三個字。

title.en: The index, a place at a time

desc.en: The list becomes one held screen. A place name set very large on the left, its photograph whole on the right. As you scroll, the next photograph is uncovered from its foot while the last one leaves along the same edge, and the name rises from under a line. The eight names sit small at the bottom; click one to go there.
desc.zh: 清單變成一個停住的畫面。左邊是很大的地名，右邊是完整的照片。往下捲時，下一張照片從底部揭開、上一張沿同一條邊離開，地名從一條線底下升上來。八個地名小小地排在下面，點一個就跳過去。

desc.en: The photograph fills the window edge to edge, above a band of paper that carries the place name and the eight small names. Scrolling uncovers the next photograph over the last. Nothing is written on the photograph. Wide photographs only, so New York is the Empire State at sunset here.
desc.zh: 照片佔滿整個畫面，下面一道紙帶寫著地名和八個小地名。往下捲，下一張照片蓋過上一張揭開。照片上不寫字。這一版只用橫的照片，所以紐約是日落的帝國大廈。

title.en: The index, one line of names

desc.en: The eight names are one line of very large type across the top that travels sideways as you scroll; the one in the middle is in ink, its neighbours pale. Under it, the photograph of that place, whole, uncovered from its foot.
desc.zh: 八個地名排成最上面一行很大的字，往下捲時整行往旁邊走；中間那個是深色，兩旁的很淡。下面是那個地方完整的照片，從底部揭開。

title.zh: 索引：加上細線，照片揭開

desc.en: The version you scored 2, kept as a list you read down but finished: a hairline between rows, the place line in small capitals at the far side, the name stepping in as it becomes current, and a larger photograph that is uncovered from its foot instead of fading.
desc.zh: 你打 2 分的那一版，還是一列往下讀的清單，但做得更細：每列之間一條細線，地點用小型大寫放在另一側，讀到的地名往內移一點，照片更大，而且是從底部揭開，不是淡入。
